summary.en: Jordan has conducted airstrikes in southern Syria targeting Islamic State militants, while Syrian authorities report civilian casualties and have condemned the raids as a breach of airspace. Syrian forces killed a French jihadist in a shootout in Harem and another French extremist in Idlib, and two Syrian defence ministry personnel were killed by unidentified gunmen in Idlib. Jordan and Syria have reopened a border crossing and agreed to a joint investigation, while Jordanian officials cite a security vacuum in the south. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jordan har gjennomført luftangrep i sørlige Syria mot IS-militante, mens syriske myndigheter rapporterer sivile tap og har fordømt raidene som et brudd på luftrommet. Syriske styrker drepte en fransk jihadist i en skuddveksling i Harem og en annen fransk ekstremist i Idlib, og to ansatte i det syriske forsvarsdepartementet ble drept av ukjente skytere i Idlib. Jordan og Syria har gjenåpnet en grenseovergang og blitt enige om en felles etterforskning, mens jordaniske tjenestemenn peker på et sikkerhetsvakuum i sør. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
